notablePrerequisites: Presence of Gond attached to a nontoken creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Presence of Gond attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elf Warrior, untapping the creature with Presence of Gond attached.
Repeat.
